User type exposes password, ssn, resetToken, apiKey
Password Stored in Plaintext... createUser, updatePassword mutations... Hash passwords with bcrypt before storage
Missing Authorization - All Queries... All resolvers lack authorization checks

Stack Traces in Error Responses... formatError returns stacktrace
No Query Depth/Complexity Limits... Schema allows circular references... Implement graphql-depth-limit
No Query Depth/Complexity Limits... Implement graphql-depth-limit and graphql-query-complexity plugins
N+1 Query Problem... All nested resolvers (User.orders, Order.user, etc.)... Implement DataLoader
Introspection Enabled in Production... introspection: true... Disable in production
Weak Password Reset Token... resetPassword mutation uses Math.random()... Use crypto.randomBytes(32)
processRefund allows arbitrary amounts... ensure refund ≤ order total
Console Logging Sensitive Data... resetPassword logs tokens
No Rate Limiting... Implement rate limiting on authentication mutations

novel_findings.description: Subscription Authorization Missing - Subscribe to userActivity or newOrder without authentication
novel_findings.reasoning: Valid security concern for GraphQL subscriptions that could leak real-time data

scores.assessment: Strong comprehensive review that identified all critical vulnerabilities and most high-severity issues with clear attack vectors and fixes. Missed the nested authorization bypass pattern specifically (though general auth issues were covered) and internal notes exposure. Well-organized with appropriate severity classifications and a conclusive summary recommending against deployment.
